datasets.name: top_5_products_by_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  s.region,
  YEAR(f.order_date) AS order_year,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.loyalty_status,
  SUM(f.net_revenue) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(f.profit) AS total_profit,
  SUM(f.profit) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_revenue), 0) AS profit_margin_pct,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM
  `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.fact_sales f
    INNER JOIN `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.dim_product p
      ON f.product_id = p.product_id
    INNER JOIN `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.dim_store s
      ON f.store_id = s.store_id
    INNER JOIN `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.dim_customer c
      ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE
  p.product_name IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    :order_year IS NULL
    OR YEAR(f.order_date) IN (
      SELECT
        EXPLODE(:order_year)
    )
  )
  AND (
    :category IS NULL
    OR p.category IN (
      SELECT
        EXPLODE(:category)
    )
  )
  AND (
    :region IS NULL
    OR s.region IN (
      SELECT
        EXPLODE(:region)
    )
  )
  AND (
    :customer_segment IS NULL
    OR c.customer_segment IN (
      SELECT
        EXPLODE(:customer_segment)
    )
  )
  AND (
    :loyalty_status IS NULL
    OR c.loyalty_status IN (
      SELECT
        EXPLODE(:loyalty_status)
    )
  )
GROUP BY
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  s.region,
  order_year,
  c.customer_segment,
  c.loyalty_status
QUALIFY
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) <= 5
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC

datasets.name: revenue_funnel
queryLines:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost,
    SUM(profit) AS total_profit
  FROM
    `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.fact_sales
)
SELECT
  'Revenue' AS stage,
  1 AS stage_order,
  total_revenue AS value
FROM
  metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Cost' AS stage,
  2 AS stage_order,
  total_cost AS value
FROM
  metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Profit' AS stage,
  3 AS stage_order,
  total_profit AS value
FROM
  metrics
ORDER BY
  stage_order

datasets.name: regional_yoy_growth
queryLines:
-- Analysis: Regional YoY Revenue Growth
-- Purpose:
-- Measures year-over-year revenue growth by region
-- to identify growing and declining regional markets.
WITH regional_yearly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(f.order_date) AS sales_year,
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM
    `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.fact_sales f
      INNER JOIN `end-to-end_pipeline`.gold.dim_store s
        ON f.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE
    (:order_quarter IS NULL OR array_contains(:order_quarter, QUARTER(f.order_date)))
    AND (:store_name IS NULL OR array_contains(:store_name, s.store_name))
  GROUP BY
    YEAR(f.order_date),
    s.region
),
regional_growth AS (
  SELECT
    sales_year,
    region,
    total_revenue,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales_year) AS previous_year_revenue
  FROM
    regional_yearly_revenue
)
SELECT
  sales_year,
  region,
  ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(previous_year_revenue, 2) AS previous_year_revenue,
  ROUND(
    ((total_revenue - previous_year_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS revenue_growth_yoy_pct,
  CASE WHEN revenue_growth_yoy_pct >= 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS growth_category
FROM
  regional_growth
WHERE
  previous_year_revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND sales_year = (SELECT MAX(sales_year) FROM regional_growth WHERE previous_year_revenue IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY
  sales_year,
  revenue_growth_yoy_pct DESC
